'''''Ertine''''' was a [[speederboat]] owned by [[Mix Liddell]], the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Security Chief (ORO)|Security Chief]] of [[Bartyn's Landing]]. Liddell named the vehicle after his predecessor and former boss, Chief [[Ertine]].
